text.name: Golbat

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Sneaky Bite
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Swoop Across
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

text.name: Crobat

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Surprise Bite
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It flies so silently and swiftly that it may not be noticed even in daytime.

text.name: Zubat

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Free Flight
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has no Energy attached to it, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

text.flavor: It does not need eyes: it emits ultrasonic waves to check the surroundings while in flight.

attacks.name: Missile Jab
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Corkscrew Smash
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

rules.label: Pokémon EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Hawlucha

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Shining Spirit
abilities.text: Damage from this Pokémon's attacks isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Flying Press
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't a Pokémon-EX, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big brawlers like Machamp and Rampardos.
